message:
Partial refunds now return the right amount. The fix is one line in `src/payments/partial-refund.js`:

```js
amount: Math.round(payment.amount * percent / 100) });
```

The function was multiplying by `percent` (documented as 0–100) without dividing by 100, so a 50% refund on a 1250 charge came back as 62500 instead of 625. `npm test` now passes all 20 tests, including `test/payments-partial-refund.test.js`.

I didn't commit anything.
